title: IT: IT Technician
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Information Technology—IT Technician Certificate of Achievement
outcomes: Design LAN and WAN logical topologies that support various sized organizations.
Assess security risks and identify ways to minimize their threat and/or impact.
Analyze various operating system options and make recommendations based on organization needs.
Demonstrate digital literacy and work habits required for a successful virtual business.
Evaluate effectiveness of web-based business tools for successful operation of a virtual business.
Develop and implement common deliverables for virtual office entrepreneur.
Diagnose common software and hardware problems.
Analyze and integrate software solutions for the business environment.
Demonstrate professional communication and customer services skills.
Analyze scenarios, investigate options, and appropriately apply workplace computer programs.

notes: Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (IT 0015, IT 0095, IT 0100, IT 0105, IT 0110); these were matched to closed-list IT 15, IT 95, IT 100, IT 105, IT 110.
Units are not printed beside the elective-list courses (BUS 0261, BUS 0265/0266, IT 0095), so their units are null; the state file stores 0.5 for IT 95, which is likely variable-unit internship.

The outcomes come from a single page-wide 'Program Student Learning Outcomes (PSLOs)' tab for the Information Technology department; it is not specific to this award (it includes virtual-office outcomes) and was recorded as shared by this certificate. Reviewer should confirm which PSLOs apply.
The AA/AS degree section with the same title prints identical major requirements; only the Certificate of Achievement section was read.
Careers are recorded from 'entry level positions in computer retail, helpdesk, system administration, computer application installation, and technically oriented administrative roles'.
